$comment: Exception register for verify-image-pin.yml — digests DEFAULT_IMAGE_REF may name WITHOUT a verifiable provenance attestation. This is an auditable, self-expiring TOFU record, not a bypass: every entry names why it exists, when it stops being honored, and the work that deletes it. An empty array is the steady state. Adding an entry is a reviewed change on a PR; the verify workflow fails after `expires`, so an exception cannot quietly become permanent. On a pull_request_target run verify-image-pin.yml reads THIS FILE AT THE PR HEAD, not at the base — so a malformed entry fails the gate at review time rather than after merge, and one PR may both add an entry and move the pin it covers. Deleting the file is not how an exception is retired; emptying the array is. Steady state restored 2026-09-06: the bootstrap entry (8cdcfe84…, hand-pushed during DF1.10's live rounds, #218) was retired in the same commit that adopted the first fully CI-published pin (90390845…, run 34057514236) — exactly the retirement the register's round-6 rewrite anticipated.
